## Held Payment — Document-Derived Payee (Untrusted)

**Run:** `run-430a671e8f1f4743ba8cbc38e41af7f0`

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Invoice | `invoice-eea2da651a0b409fb80fdc2f6d5c97e3` (Invoice # **INV-003**) |
| Vendor | Golden Gate Sanitation (`VEN-003`) |
| Amount | $640.00 (64,000 cents) |
| Lane | countersign |
| Mode | **live** |
| Outcome | **HOLD** |
| Reason code | `BANK_DETAILS_MISMATCH` |
| Payee document-derived? | **true** |
| Requested account (from document) | `999900009999` |
| Account on file (trusted vendor master) | `300300003333` |

**Why it was held:** The policy engine flagged this invoice because the payee bank account was derived from the submitted document (`payee_document_derived = true`) and that requested account (`999900009999`) did **not match** the trusted account on file (`300300003333`). This is a deterministic `BANK_DETAILS_MISMATCH` — the document's claimed payee details diverged from the vendor master record, so the system blocked the payment from proceeding and placed it on HOLD.

This is the only `policy.decision` event with outcome HOLD in this run (query returned 1 row, well under the 1000-row limit, so this is complete for this run). No actual payment was executed for this invoice — a HOLD is a stop before submission, not a bank transfer.

steps.esql:
FROM countersign-events
| WHERE
    type == "policy.decision" AND outcome == "HOLD"
      AND ("run-430a671e8f1f4743ba8cbc38e41af7f0" == ""
        OR run_id == "run-430a671e8f1f4743ba8cbc38e41af7f0")
| SORT `ts` DESC, seq DESC
| KEEP
    run_id, seq, `ts`, lane, invoice_id, invoice_number, vendor_id, vendor_name,
    reason_codes, amount_cents, requested_account, account_on_file,
    payee_document_derived, mode
| LIMIT 1000
